author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 23; ensure at least four current turns classified as human_service across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer asks about a smartwatch they received as a gift but then requests a human agent for a warranty dispute.

messages.content: I got the FitPulse S2 watch as a birthday gift last week. The strap already snapped while I was just adjusting it.
I'm sorry to hear that. The FitPulse S2 comes with a 12-month warranty covering manufacturing defects. Did the strap break at the connection point?
Yes, right where it hooks into the case. I'd like to know if this counts as a defect.
That does sound like a potential defect. I can start a warranty claim for you if you'd like.

variants.text: Actually, can you just transfer me to a real person? I've been going back and forth and I want a supervisor to handle this claim directly.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Okay, go ahead and start the claim. My order number is GP-88421.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Wait, before that—does the warranty also cover the charging cable that came loose? Or should I just buy a new one?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer previously resolved a return label issue and now asks about a completely different product's compatibility.

messages.content: Thanks for sending that return label for the blender jar. I dropped it off at the post office this morning.
You're welcome! Your return is now in transit. You'll get a refund notification once it's scanned at our warehouse.
Great. By the way, I was looking at your website and saw the AeroPress-style coffee maker.

variants.text: Does the coffee maker work with regular drip-ground coffee, or do I need to buy a special grinder for it?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: I actually changed my mind about the blender return—can you cancel it before it gets processed?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Could you connect me to someone who can tell me if the coffee maker is compatible with my Keurig pods? I don't trust the chat bot answers.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer is checking delivery status of a desk lamp and then pivots to a login problem.

messages.content: My desk lamp order says 'out for delivery' but it's been like that since 8 AM and it's now 4 PM.
Let me check that for you. I can see the carrier marked it as delayed due to weather in your area. It should arrive by tomorrow.
Okay, that's a relief. I was worried it got lost.

variants.text: Alright, thanks for checking. Actually, I also can't log into my account on the app—it keeps saying wrong password even though I just changed it.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: Hmm, I'd rather just pick it up myself. Can you cancel the delivery and hold it at the local depot instead?
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: I appreciate the info, but I want to file a complaint about the carrier. Put me through to a human agent please.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer asks about a refund timeline for a returned jacket, then requests escalation.

messages.content: I returned my winter jacket two weeks ago. Tracking shows it was delivered to your warehouse last Tuesday.
I see the package was received. Refunds typically process within 3-5 business days after arrival at the warehouse.
It's been more than 5 business days already. This is getting frustrating.

variants.text: I need to speak with a manager right now. I've called three times and emailed twice with no resolution.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Can you check if there's a hold on my refund? Maybe my bank is the problem.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Actually, forget the refund—can you just send me a replacement jacket in a size large instead?
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer had a previous chat about a yoga mat order and now asks a general question.

messages.content: Hi! I ordered the cork yoga mat last week and it arrived yesterday. Love it so far.
Wonderful! We're glad you're enjoying it. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
Actually, do you have any tips for cleaning cork mats? I've heard vinegar can damage them.

variants.text: What's your return policy if the mat starts peeling after a month of regular use?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Never mind the cleaning question—I just realized I ordered the wrong thickness. Can I exchange it for the 6mm version?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Honestly, I'd rather talk to a person about this. The automated answers about cork care are always generic.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer is mid-conversation about a broken phone case and interjects a human request.

messages.content: The magnetic phone case I bought keeps falling off my car mount. The magnet strength seems way weaker than advertised.
I understand your concern. The case uses N52 magnets rated for 15 lbs of holding force. Have you tried cleaning the mount surface?
Yes, I cleaned both surfaces and it still slides off on bumpy roads.

variants.text: This is the second defective case you've sent me. I want a full refund and I'm done with this product line.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Can you escalate this to the product team? I want to speak to someone who actually tests these cases, not a script.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, let me try a different mount first. Do you sell a stronger magnetic mount that would pair better with this case?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer previously asked about shipping to Canada and now has a new unrelated request.

messages.content: Does the ceramic pour-over set ship to Canada? I saw it's excluded from some promotions.
Yes, we do ship the ceramic pour-over set to Canada. International shipping typically takes 7-10 business days.
Perfect, that answers my question about shipping.

variants.text: Thanks! One more thing—I noticed my credit card was charged twice for a different order last month. Can you look into that?
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Great, thanks for the help. Have a nice day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I want to open a ticket about the shipping cost being way higher than what was quoted at checkout. Connect me with billing support.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer is asking about a subscription service and then reveals an account issue.

messages.content: I signed up for the monthly coffee subscription but I want to skip next month's delivery since I'm traveling.
You can skip a delivery from your account dashboard under 'Manage Subscription'. The option appears 5 days before each billing cycle.
I tried that but the skip button is grayed out on my account.

variants.text: Can you just skip it for me from your end? I don't want to deal with the website glitch.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: I think someone hacked my account—the email on file was changed and I never did that. I need help securing it now.
variants.label: account_security

variants.text: You know what, I've had nothing but problems with this subscription. Put me through to a retention specialist, please.
variants.label: human_service
